# Results (auto-generated by `scripts/collect_results.py` from outputs/*)

Mean ± sample std (ddof = 1) over seeds; 95 % CIs = percentile bootstrap over test images (2000 resamples) of one representative run. Test supports (split 0): class 1: 11, 2: 2, 3: 802, 4: 58, 5: 1, 6: 45 — classes 2 and 5 make 6-class macro-F1 volatile, so a 4-class macro-F1 (classes 1, 3, 4, 6) is reported alongside.

## Few-shot classification — 6-class macro-F1 (test split)

DINOv2: frozen features (FP32 on all splits); `linear` = logistic regression with C selected on the labelled val split (optimistic for few-shot), `linear_C1` = untuned C = 1, `proto` = CL2N prototypes, `knn1` = cosine 1-NN; mean ± sd over 3 split seeds × 5 support seeds (k-shot) or 3 split seeds (full). ResNet-18: split 0; k-shot = 5 seeds, last checkpoint (no val selection); full = 3 seeds, best-on-val checkpoint.

## Anomaly localisation on defect images — off-mask normals (lead task)

Normal bank: class-6 train images + patches > 16 px from the mask of 300 train defect images; evaluation on the 874 test defect images only (normal pixels = off-mask pixels). Pixel AP and AUPRO@5 % are the discriminative metrics here; pixel AUROC / AUPRO@30 % are dominated by easy background.

## Batch-1 latency on the Colab L4 (NVIDIA L4, torch 2.14.1+cu130)

model = GPU-resident input → raw output; e2e = host uint8 477×477 image → resize/normalise → model → mask / map back on the host (YOLO: Ultralytics `predict`). U-Net and PatchCore use random weights (latency does not depend on them); PatchCore kNN = PyTorch backends over a 38,740 × 1024 bank.

| model | params | model FP32 p50 / p99 ms | model FP16 p50 / p99 ms | e2e FP32 p50 ms | e2e FP16 p50 ms |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| YOLO26n-seg (480 px) | 2.7 M | 11.34 / 11.61 | 12.32 / 13.47 | 12.35 | 13.47 |
| U-Net-R18 (256 px) | 14.3 M | 4.17 / 4.26 | 5.50 / 5.82 | 4.64 | 5.95 |
| PatchCore WRN-50 + kNN (256 px) | 24.9 M | 22.71 / 23.66 | 17.79 / 18.08 | 23.19 | 18.30 |

## Detector benchmark (Colab L4; boxes = mask connected components; seed 0)

Same split, 480 px input, 35 epochs for every model; test split 919 images (5 defect classes, class-6 images as background). COCO metrics by pycocotools (100 detections per image); small = area < 32² px. GFLOPs counted with one counter (torch FlopCounterMode, math attention) at 1×3×480×480. Latency: L4, batch 1, FP16, 50 warm-up calls excluded, p50 over 300 calls.
